in_sanskrit.name: Pravansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pravansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Pravansh is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'pravana', which means 'journey' or 'movement'. The name Pravansh is a combination of 'pravana' and 'sh', which means 'Lord'. Thus, Pravansh can be interpreted as 'Lord of the Universe' or 'Lord of Journeys'.
